title: She Was Not High Maintenance
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: Aachu's little needs, soft impracticality, and full-alive green-dress energy are not high-maintenance when Zuv notices early and turns the tiny discomfort into gentle care.
emotional_arc: universal high-maintenance anti-label -> Aachu fully alive on the balcony -> bare-feet green-dress proof -> Zuv notices before she asks -> care-without-shrinking thesis
source_story_summary:
Selected concept from the Golden Theme tournament: She Was Not High-Maintenance.

Aachu is in a green dress on the Ayatana balcony, barefoot and fully alive.
She is not difficult; she is soft, expressive, dressed up, slightly impractical,
and trying to keep the moment beautiful for one more second.

Zuv notices the tiny discomfort before she asks. He kneels to help with her
shoes/sandals without making it dramatic, without making her feel like a
burden, and without asking her to become easier.

Golden Theme score: 29.5/30.

Public slide copy must be exactly:
Slide 1: She was not high-maintenance.
Slide 2: She was just fully alive.
Slide 3: Bare feet. Green dress. Tiny crisis.
Slide 4: He noticed before she asked.
Slide 5: Maybe love is care without shrinking.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable Instagram carousel slide in a soft hand-drawn flat vector / desi storybook illustration style matching the supplied reference carousel examples. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but with the richer model-native handwritten text, faces, outfits, and brandmark composition shown in the style references. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

concept_selection.source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles.
concept_selection.selector_verdict: Winner starts from the universal shame of being called high-maintenance, uses Aachu's green-dress barefoot balcony moment as proof, keeps Zuv's care active, and preserves the gold theme by making the small need safe instead of burdensome.
concept_selection.calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the first-principles machine: universal anti-ideal -> expressive Aachu proof -> Zuv's active steady care -> tender acceptance thesis.
final_public_slide_copy_direction: Bare feet. Green dress. Tiny crisis.
Maybe love is care without shrinking.

candidates.name: She Was Not High-Maintenance
candidates.universal_truth: The right person does not make your little needs feel like a burden.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu fully alive in a green dress, barefoot, soft, and slightly impractical.
candidates.concrete_proof: Zuv kneeling on the Ayatana balcony to help with footwear before she asks.
candidates.zuv_role: He notices the tiny discomfort early and turns it into gentle care.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is care without asking someone to shrink.

candidates.universal_truth: Some people bring the whole scene; some love handles the details that keep it soft.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Green-dress main-character entrance on the balcony.
candidates.concrete_proof: Footwear help, steady posture, soft smile.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv becomes the quiet detail person without making her smaller.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is not dimming the scene; it is making it easier to live inside.

candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Barefoot, soft, slightly impractical balcony moment.

candidates.universal_truth: Romance is often the unglamorous detail that protects the beautiful moment.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is the logistics nobody claps for.
